limitations: Component-assembled costs are not an end-to-end production tag/release sequence.
Queue, setup, fresh guards, real API transport and producer sealing are outside the measured component cost scope.
Hosted experiments use simulated API eligibility and trust; production release gates remain unchanged.
Artifacts have seven-day expiry; this JSON retains compact digests and measurements, not binaries or full logs.

measurements.cost_scope: Observed components assembled as producer once + two consumers; excludes queue, setup, fresh preflight/static/network guards, real API transport and producer sealing; not an end-to-end production measurement.

formulas.reuse_critical_sequence: max(P_linux, P_windows) + median_i(max(tag_linux_i, tag_windows_i)) + median_i(max(release_linux_i, release_windows_i))
formulas.reuse_runner_sequence: P_linux + P_windows + median_i(tag_linux_i + tag_windows_i) + median_i(release_linux_i + release_windows_i)
formulas.statistics: median, min and max of the three actual samples; no assumed speedup

protocol.cache_hits_source: setup actions outputs; null means unavailable
protocol.fallback_invalidation: simulated drift of fresh Windows facts.image_version; full decision required before real heavy suites
protocol.postdecision_loss: successful reuse followed by missing linux/.coverage must be refused
